page.overview:
Who is Bludo?

When arrives at , he will find cursing in frustration. He explains that the rampages have worsened the eruptions from . There is a legend that, 100 years ago, it used to protect the , but states that times have changed since then. has disrupted the 's operations, leading to suffering for all of the . In his anger, accidentally throws out his back, though he dismisses it when asks if he is alright.

At this point in the conversation, realizes he does not know who is. When reveals that he is a traveler, is honored that he came so far to pay his respects to him. He then properly introduces himself to . He quietly wonders where went, explaining that he is a young who helps him with the task. However, he has not returned after setting out to the to retrieve 's painkillers. Believing that is slacking off, asks to tell to return if he sees him. With this, the "" will begin.

After rescues and returns to , reveals that told what happened. Since need rewards, gives three . Now that he has taken his painkillers, is ready to meet up with to face . While he does not wish to disrespect the legacy of , he is eager to send the back again. At 's confusion, is shocked to hear that he does not know who is. He points out the , explaining that it depicts . Seeing the statue triggers the "" .

Although is confused by 's reaction, he adds that Yunobo is a descendant of Daruk, and is thus able to use his ability. reveals that uses it to stay safe while they fire him at , as it is the only way to scare it off. Just as is about to leave to meet up with , his back flares up again. With no other choice, he is forced to cancel his plans. He asks to find Yunobo at the and inform him of the news.
